title: Fynaptix · Quantum Computing Research
heading: Quantum Computing Intelligence
subheading: Pure-plays, hedged giants & the road to commercial advantage
disclaimer: Not financial advice. This page organizes public information for research purposes only — not a recommendation to buy or sell any security. Quantum pure-plays trade at extreme valuations (P/S ~54–418×), are funding themselves with heavy dilution and are highly speculative — position sizing matters more here than anywhere else on this hub. Verify current prices and do your own due diligence before investing.

kpis.label: Quantum technologies market projection; a Benchmark analyst puts 2026 industry revenue at only ~$1.5B, and Morgan Stanley projects a $100B market by 2040.

After last week's dilution-driven crash, the group stalled near its lows: Oct 16→Oct 23 closes: IonQ $31.28→$31.27 (0%), Rigetti $11.80→$11.52 (−2%), D-Wave $11.78→$11.66 (−1%), Quantinuum $36.55→$36.50 (0%), Pasqal $5.67→$5.56 (−2%), QTUM $137.14→$136.20 (−1%). On Oct 22 an AI/chip selloff (Lam Research warned some December-quarter shipments could slip to March) erased a one-day rally: IonQ −3%, Quantinuum −7%, Rigetti −5%, D-Wave −4%. Over one month IonQ is −24%, D-Wave −35% and Rigetti −31%.

Both report on the same day. IonQ's FY26 guidance is $450–460M (consensus ~$455M, vs $130M in 2025) and it trades near 20× forward sales, just above a five-year low of 19× hit Oct 19; Q2 revenue was $80.05M. The $2B equity offering (Oct 14) is done and the all-stock Elisity deal (up to $1.3B, issue-price collar $33.07–$49.61) is expected to close in Q4, so further share issuance is still ahead.

IonQ $31.27 (~$13.43B mkt cap / $246.5M TTM revenue, P/S ~54×) / Rigetti $11.52 (~$3.85B / $13.35M, ~288×) / D-Wave $11.66 (~$4.34B / $12.43M, ~349×) / Quantinuum $36.50 (~$9.61B / $22.97M, ~418×); Infleqtion $8.75 (~$1.97B / $42.44M, ~46×); Pasqal $5.56 (~$1.18B mkt cap); Defiance Quantum ETF (QTUM) $136.20 (~$5.15B AUM), 20% below its 52-week high of $170. Ratios are computed from market cap and TTM revenue.

tiers.label: Hedged Giants — Quantum as an Option
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list. Most quantum systems remain in R&D; true commercial systems are likely years away.

rows.angle: DARPA QBI Stage C (since Oct 7) is backed by the Oct 8 Pentagon package: ~$200M of new DARPA funding across the four new Stage C teams (IBM, IonQ, Atom Computing, Diraq). Builds on Nighthawk r2 and Anderon CHIPS foundry funding. No new IBM-specific quantum headline this week
rows.watch for: Stage C award size for IBM (not disclosed); Albany 300mm foundry yield ramp; progress against the 2029 fault-tolerant Starling roadmap

rows.angle: No new hardware headline since the Sep 22 logical-qubit stability milestone; still a lab result, and Google is not in DARPA Stage C. Quantinuum's Oct 19 claim of logical fidelity ~100× better than Google's best published superconducting result (company-reported) sharpens the competitive comparison
rows.watch for: Scaling stable logical qubits into larger arrays; any commercial Willow-class access; overlap with your AI-sleeve Alphabet exposure

rows.angle: Majorana 2 remains with DARPA for independent testing at the new Maryland center; Microsoft and PsiQuantum have been in QBI Stage C since before the Oct 7 additions
rows.watch for: Independent test results on the topological-qubit claims; Quantinuum partnership developments

rows.angle: Oct 8: $1B five-year US science commitment (AI, quantum, healthcare, energy) and Genesis Mission collaborator; CUDA-Q and NVQLink tie quantum hardware to GPU systems. Caught in the Oct 22 AI/chip selloff alongside the quantum names
rows.watch for: How much of the $1B reaches quantum; new NVQLink adopters; quantum remains immaterial to NVIDIA's revenue

private_watchlist.name: PsiQuantum
private_watchlist.note: In DARPA QBI Stage C with Microsoft ($125M award Jul 23, up to $300M) and finalized a $100M CHIPS R&D award on Sep 8. On Oct 8 the Pentagon package added a conditional loan of up to $150M from the Office of Strategic Capital for its Milpitas, California hub; final commitment depends on conditions. private_watchlist.name: Atom Computing
private_watchlist.note: Joined QBI Stage C on Oct 7 alongside IBM, IonQ and Diraq; no listed security, so it is only a read-across for neutral-atom peers such as Pasqal and Infleqtion.

private_watchlist.name: QuEra
private_watchlist.note: Previously reported 96 verified logical qubits and a DARPA QBI Stage B slot (not re-verified this week); not among the Stage C names. Infleqtion is now listed (INFQ, see Tier 2).

bear_case.title: Years from commercial advantage
bear_case.description: IonQ's ~$13.4B market cap sits on $246.5M of trailing revenue and roughly half of its FY26 guidance is inorganic (SkyWater). D-Wave's trailing revenue is $12.43M, down 44% YoY; Quantinuum booked about $8M last quarter, with ~$30M expected for 2026. Quantinuum's Oct 19 fidelity record is company-reported and a lab result, not revenue.

bear_case.title: Dilution is now the dominant story
bear_case.description: IonQ raised $2B in equity on Oct 14 two days after agreeing an all-stock Elisity deal of up to $1.3B, taking shares outstanding from ~405M toward 430M+ before the pre-funded warrants and deal shares; the Elisity shares are still to be issued. Commerce also holds minority equity stakes alongside $100M CHIPS awards to Rigetti, D-Wave and Quantinuum. A month on, IonQ is still −24%.

bear_case.title: Rates and the AI trade are the swing factor
bear_case.description: The Fed raised to 3.75–4.00% in September and meets again Oct 27–28 (last week's reporting put hike odds near 40%; sources differ). On Oct 22, supply-constraint comments from Lam Research alone knocked IonQ, Rigetti, D-Wave and Quantinuum 3–7% in a day with no company news; Rigetti and D-Wave have betas above 2.

bear_case.title: Drawdowns remain brutal
bear_case.description: IonQ is ~58% below its 52-week high, Rigetti sits just above its $11.11 low (high $44.52), D-Wave is ~3% above its $11.26 low (high $37.62), Quantinuum is ~58% below its post-IPO high, Pasqal is at its low (~77% below its high) and Infleqtion is near its $8.38 low. Law-firm fraud investigations now touch D-Wave and Pasqal.

bear_case.title: The winner may not be listed or pure-play
bear_case.description: Microsoft, IBM, PsiQuantum, Atom Computing and Diraq sit in QBI Stage C alongside IonQ; PsiQuantum, Atom and Diraq are private and two are giants where quantum is a rounding error. Rigetti, D-Wave and Quantinuum are not on the list. DARPA's 'up to $300M' is a ceiling subject to appropriations, and headline milestones can oversell (Infleqtion's 30 logical qubits rely on error detection, not correction).

catalysts.title: AI/chip selloff erases the quantum bounce
catalysts.description: Lam Research warned supply constraints could push some December-quarter shipments into March; Quantinuum −7%, Rigetti −5%, D-Wave −4%, IonQ −3% with no company-specific news. IonQ's forward sales multiple fell back to ~20×, near its five-year low of 19×.

catalysts.title: Quantinuum reports record 99.9995% logical fidelity
catalysts.description: Company-reported result on Helios using a color code (about 5 logical errors per million operations, ~100× better than Google's best published superconducting result per Quantinuum); reaffirms universal fault tolerance by 2029. Shares stayed flat for the week at $36.50.

catalysts.title: Law firms announce D-Wave securities-fraud investigations
catalysts.description: Notices followed a ~9.5% one-day share drop; these are investigations, not filed claims. Pasqal faces similar notices (Oct 12).

catalysts.title: IonQ: Elisity deal (up to $1.3B) and $2B equity raise
catalysts.description: All-stock zero-trust cybersecurity acquisition expected to close in Q4 (collar $33.07–$49.61), followed by a $2B offering of shares and pre-funded warrants; the whole group sold off 10–22% that week.

catalysts.title: Federal Reserve meeting (upcoming)
catalysts.description: Policy rate is 3.75–4.00% after September's hike; rate expectations have been the main driver of quantum multiple compression.

catalysts.title: IonQ and Quantinuum report Q3 results (upcoming)

stance.basis: Weights are a share of a hypothetical 100% sleeve for THIS SECTOR only — not a share of your portfolio. Core and Speculative names carry the weight; Watch and Avoid deliberately carry 0% because the point of those groups is that you are not holding them yet.

positions.name: IonQ
